entries.reason: No Aleph state or observation callable represents CDH1 transcript abundance.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: Do not map CDH1 expression directly to an adhesion stiffness or bond count.

entries.reason: Aleph has a vimentin-labelled mechanical population, but no callable maps that population to VIM transcript abundance.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: A shared biological name is not an observation operator or a calibrated constitutive bridge.

entries.reason: No Aleph state or observation callable represents E-cadherin protein abundance.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: Do not equate protein intensity with a focal-adhesion or cell-cell adhesion parameter.

entries.reason: The vimentin mechanical population has no validated protein-intensity observation model.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer filament number, topology, or stiffness from intensity without an independently validated bridge.

entries.reason: Aleph exposes the accepted-step cell-to-ECM traction resultant, but tissue-TFM geometry, per-cell/ROI aggregation, and nN-per-cell validation are not yet established.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: A force-bearing callable is not a unit- and geometry-matched TFM operator.

entries.reason: Aleph's ERM membrane-cortex spring is not an AFM membrane-tube plateau-force observation model, so no source callable is registered.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: Do not reuse an ERM tether force merely because both quantities contain the word tether.

entries.reason: Aleph exposes the total method-of-planes tension over all load-bearing elements, but equivalence to the dynamic AFM parallel-plate effective Laplace operator has not yet been validated at matched geometry and protocol.
entries.forbidden_shortcut: Matching dimensions and a source-code claim of AFM/Laplace comparability do not establish a geometry-matched observation operator.
